recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, multi-layered graphic composition featuring bold, vertically-compressed typography, duotone portraiture, and a modular grid of color blocks and vertical bars against a distressed black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme vertical elongation of letterforms against horizontal color bands
Duotone halftone portraits framed within narrow vertical apertures
Contrast between vibrant magenta/blue blocks and stark white display text
Heavy textural distressing suggesting aged cardboard and ink wear
coreInvariants: Black background as the primary negative space
Vertical bar motif dividing the lower half of the composition
High-contrast serif and sans-serif typographic hierarchy

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Typography dominates the top two-thirds; four small-scale portraits occupy the bottom third within vertical frames.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white, centered title in the middle-ground acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical flow, starting with the magenta header, moving through the white title, and settling on the portrait grid at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and packed; black space is used to separate text blocks and define the vertical framing.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black provides the foundational depth and contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant Magenta and Cyan-Blue create a split-complementary pop against the black.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and Orange-Yellow provide legibility for secondary and tertiary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the color blocks paired with high-value white text creates a vibrating, energetic 1960s palette.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to 4-5 spot colors plus black

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-condensed serifs and wide, geometric sans-serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Extreme vertical scaling on primary display fonts
Uniform stroke weight on geometric sans-serifs
Tight letter spacing (kerning) to create a block-like texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: O and G characters in the main title are nearly circular
Serifs on the top header are elongated and sharp
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between vertically stretched serifs and horizontally expanded sans-serifs.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and high contrast of the primary display text.
Matches the wide, geometric sans-serif used for secondary information.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a black background with a grid of four vertical rectangles at the bottom. Fill the rectangles with high-contrast halftone portraits in magenta and red duotone. Add a large magenta block at the top left and a blue block at the top right. Apply a heavy weathered cardboard texture with white scuffs and ink wear overall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset the primary header in an ultra-condensed bold serif, vertically stretched. Typeset the central title in a bold, wide serif with quotation marks. Add secondary text in a wide geometric sans-serif. Use orange-yellow for the tracklist on the sides.

verificationChecks: Ensure the vertical bars align with the portrait frames.
Check that the 'distress' texture does not obscure legibility.
Verify the color palette is limited to magenta, blue, orange, white, and black.

adjustableVariables: Degree of vertical stretching on the header text
Saturation of the magenta and blue blocks
Amount of simulated paper wear and scuffing
mustRedesign: Replace specific artist names and song titles with generic placeholders
Remove any specific record label logos
Ensure portraits are generic representations, not specific celebrities
postGenerationChecks: Is the typography the dominant element?
Does the texture feel like aged cardboard?
Are the portraits rendered in a high-contrast halftone style?
Is the color palette restricted and vibrant?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Ultra-Condensed Serif] + [Wide Sans-Serif] + [Duotone Halftone Portraits] + [Weathered Black Background] + [Primary Color Blocking].
